# paperclip_project (Data Source)

Reads Paperclip project details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "paperclip_project" "core" {
  company_id = data.paperclip_company.acme.id
  name       = "core-platform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `company_id` (String) The Paperclip company ID.
- `id` (String) Project unique identifier.
- `name` (String) Project identifier name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Project description.
- `lead_agent_id` (String) Assigned lead agent ID.
